rationale: We landed on monclergroup.com (corporate) instead of the ecommerce domain. The patches force entry and navigation to moncler.com with a stable en-us locale, block corporate host, and normalize any off-locale redirects (e.g., en-jp). Added resilient PLP/PDP selectors and OneTrust cookie handling to reach and parse product tiles. Code hints address the AttributeError by guarding the missing _force_plp_recover hook and implement safe recovery to a canonical PLP.

Domain sanity check + recovery when on corporate site:

if "monclergroup.com" in page.url:
    link = await page.query_selector("a[href*='moncler.com']")
    if link:
        await link.click()
        await page.wait_for_url("**moncler.com/**")
    else:
        await page.goto("https://www.moncler.com/en-us/")
